svg.title: Cmod A7-35T accessory connection map / карта соединений
svg.desc: Pmod JA connects to Tiny VGA. DIP 26 to 28 connect directly to TM1638 DIO, CLK and STB. TM1638 VCC and signal pull-ups use the accessory 3.3 volt regulator, which also powers INMP441. DIP 29 to 31 connect to INMP441. DIP 32 to 34 connect to either DAC. DIP 24 supplies USB-derived VU to the DAC supply input and the 3.3 volt regulator input; DIP 25 is common ground. This is not a physical breadboard-hole layout.
svg.text: Cmod A7-35T · Tiny VGA + INMP441 + TM1638 + DAC
